text:
maya (finance): quick sync 1: follow-up on billing postmortem. symptom: delayed event ingestion + occasional duplicate token writes causing overbilling. need owners + firm ETAs.

maya (finance): proposed tasks: 
- RC sweep to produce per-account delta file (owner: igor)
- Idempotent backfill into ledger (owner: jun)
- Credit memo pipeline + approval flow (owner: oscar/rachel)
- Monitoring/alerting + runbook (owner: hana)
- CI test to prevent duplicate writes (owner: igor/jun)

maya (finance): spreadsheet: https://redwood.internal/sheets/pm-billing-2417 — please add GH links and short notes.

remediation-bot: Incident: PG-2026-03-11-delayed-ingest published: https://redwood.internal/incidents/PG-2026-03-11

igor (eng-infra): taking RC + CI test. initial look: consumer retry path sometimes loses dedupe id. will add tracing and a counter metric. ETA RC baseline: 3/09, CI test: 3/16. created GH #4330.

jun (eng-ml): taking backfill. need the delta CSV format (customer_id, window_start, window_end, token_delta, provenance_checksum). if finance ok, can run dry-run against sandbox and finish live backfill by 3/12. GH #4334.

hana (eng-sre): adding alert: billing_ingest_delay_seconds > 1800 or dedupe_fail_rate > 0.02 for 5m. will include escalation to #eng-oncall and #finance. ETA 3/08. GH #4332.

rachel (product): oscar and I will own customer comms and approvals. request: top-25 revenue customers flagged for manual review. drafting communication template. GH #4336.

oscar (finance-lead): added top-25 to the sheet and rough credit estimate. want eng to provide dry-run CSV + sha256 checksum column for verification before we issue credits. ETA approvals 3/13. GH #4337.

igor (eng-infra): will include checksum in dry-run export. also planning a short smoke job to validate idempotency.

jun (eng-ml): will validate idempotency and sign off on dry-run. note: we'll skip events older than 120 days unless finance approves. mark aged rows accordingly.

maya (finance): good. two operational asks: 1) add GH numbers to actions column; 2) set Slack reminders 24h before ETAs. I'll run remediation review on 3/18.

hana (eng-sre): scheduled weekly ingestion health check for 4 weeks post-fix. will post dashboard link.

rachel (product): customer comm draft ready for review, will post in thread shortly.

oscar (finance-lead): please ping me if dry-run shows >1% variance from estimate. we'll hold credits until we reconcile.

maya (finance): thanks all. updating tracker now. small follow-up: igor/jun please attach dry-run CSV to sheet and tag oscar for approval. closing for now. :white_check_mark:
